Review follow-up from T5, PR #614, source review `20260924T173930-48d7d0804fc3a745642f660d`, C-005/C-007. This is an operability investigation, not an audited architecture slice or a new program blocker.

The private outcome ledger ACK lookup scans up to 32,768 entries; persistent-congestion evaluation scans that retained ring again. Storage and work are finite, and no T5 latency target fails, but this cost deserves evaluation before public activation.

Define an authorized workload and latency/CPU budget, then measure the current path under that finite scope. If the cost is material, compare a bounded per-space lookup or classified-prefix approach while preserving ACK-only gaps, cross-space ordering, missing-history conservatism and ending-ordinal deduplication. Reviewer scratch timings are diagnostic, not qualification evidence. This issue does not authorize an unbounded benchmark, new maintained harness, or a change to the accepted frontier.

Revalidated against merged commit `e1ce634d9d3fcd2a4873ff865f0264ab52b6ec31`: [ACK lookup at `internal/ackhandler/bbr_recovery.go:160`](https://github.com/the-sarge/quic-go-fast/blob/e1ce634d9d3fcd2a4873ff865f0264ab52b6ec31/internal/ackhandler/bbr_recovery.go#L160) and [persistent-span reduction at line 213](https://github.com/the-sarge/quic-go-fast/blob/e1ce634d9d3fcd2a4873ff865f0264ab52b6ec31/internal/ackhandler/bbr_recovery.go#L213) each scan the retained ring; [the cap at line 13](https://github.com/the-sarge/quic-go-fast/blob/e1ce634d9d3fcd2a4873ff865f0264ab52b6ec31/internal/ackhandler/bbr_recovery.go#L13) remains 32,768. The receipt predicate does not change the scan shape. Related #613 concerns a separate ECN ledger; coordinate any accepted measurement scope, without combining their ownership or correctness contracts.

comments.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement
**Summary:** Measure the bounded recovery outcome ledger's ACK-processing cost in six finite local workloads, optionally compare one temporary optimization, and publish an evidence-backed keep/change recommendation.

**Decision authority:** The maintainer accepted the six workloads below and delegated the remaining investigation decisions with advance acceptance of the agent's recommendations. This brief authorizes investigation and, conditionally, one disposable comparison. It does not authorize shipping an optimization. This is standalone operability work, not an audited architecture slice, a new BBR program blocker or an expansion of the qualification campaign. The `ready-for-agent` role denotes readiness for this brief; do not route it through `implement-architecture-slice` merely because of that label's legacy description.

**Current behavior and verification:** Source inspection at default-branch revision `b6f34a5576a3d57af85a2bbdb25e3900163a06e4` confirms that `recoveryEvidence.ack` scans the retained outcome ring, capped at 32,768 entries, and ACK-driven `recoveryEvidence.feedback` scans it again to evaluate persistent congestion. `AckFrame.AcksPacket` searches ACK ranges for packet numbers inside their bounds. The existing key map serves other operations; it does not remove these scans. Real recovery tests cover the relevant evidence semantics. No performance regression has been reproduced and no cost qualification is claimed. Searches of recovery implementation, dispatch, tests and accepted BBR plans found no completed measurement or implemented alternative resolving this request; no out-of-scope rejection records were present. Related #613 concerns a separate ECN ledger.

**Desired behavior:** Produce reproducible, explicitly local diagnostic evidence, with honest limits and a finite decision. Keep the baseline if it meets the investigation thresholds, if attributable cost is small, or if an alternative is not convincingly better. An inconclusive result is valid and must identify the missing evidence without silently extending the budget.

**Authorized workload:** Exactly six primary cells: retained outcome counts of 1,024, 8,192 and 32,768, each with either one contiguous ACK range or 32 disjoint ACK ranges. Use a local single-connection, single ACK-processing worker workload through the real `sentPacketHandler.ReceivedAck` entrypoint with the private rich-event path active. Keep ECN validation disabled to avoid incorporating #613. Use the same fixed number of newly acknowledged packets in both range shapes, with at least one newly acknowledged ack-eliciting packet on each measured call; describe the exact packet-number layout. Use legal registrations and validated ACKs, not fabricated invalid handler state. Reach retained-ring occupancy through history rather than assuming that many simultaneously outstanding packets are legal. Verify actual occupancy and that both scans execute; do not time an already-drained duplicate-ACK shortcut. Pin and record the trace before baseline capture. Ordinary 1-RTT traffic is the timing workload; cross-space and lifecycle coverage remains in the existing correctness tests rather than multiplying timing cells.

Exclude construction, registration, fixture reset, assertions, result formatting and an accumulating test recorder from timed ACK work. Use a bounded sink that consumes emitted values. Keep setup/cache effects identical for baseline and candidate and disclose their limits. Record the source SHA, any scratch patch, commands, Go version, OS, CPU, worker settings and relevant host contention. These synthetic local cases establish neither a deployed ACK rate nor network performance.

**Metrics and investigation triggers:** Record mean time per ACK, allocations/bytes per ACK, and local p99 elapsed ACK-call time. The proposed triggers are mean greater than 10 microseconds or p99 greater than 100 microseconds in any cell. Ten microseconds corresponds arithmetically to 10% of one core at a hypothetical 10,000 ACKs/second if that time is CPU service time; elapsed measurements and profiles do not establish that deployment load or exact utilization. These are investigation triggers only, not product SLOs, qualification gates or new activation blockers. Report all six cells and run-to-run variation. Measure p99 from individual operations, never from benchmark averages; retain sample counts and timer-overhead checks. If timing resolution, setup effects or host noise prevents interpretation, mark the result inconclusive rather than claiming a threshold pass or failure. Unprofiled runs own timing results; bounded profiles attribute cost to the lookup, span reducer and surrounding recovery work.

**Finite execution budget:** At most four elapsed working hours from investigation start through the report, including setup, analysis and any candidate, with at most 30 minutes of cumulative measurement execution including warm-up, timed fixture setup and profiling. No new hosts, platform matrix or external network campaign. Initial baseline: at most three unprofiled timing samples per cell, each targeting two seconds of measured ACK work. Tail collection: at most 10,000 individual ACK durations per cell per implementation, separate from profiled runs. Take at most one 10-second CPU profile per implementation for the highest-mean-cost cell. Check timer overhead once per implementation. All work remains subordinate to the wall-time limits; stop early if they are reached. No automatic retries, sample-count growth or search for passing numbers. Publish a partial receipt and explicit limitation if valid measurements cannot be obtained within the budget.

**Conditional comparison:** A valid trigger exceedance permits at most one temporary candidate only when attribution shows either outcome scan materially contributes to the excess. A trigger caused by unrelated work, profiling overhead or host noise does not authorize an unrelated optimization. Select either a bounded per-space lookup or a classified-prefix approach based on that evidence; do not try both. If comparing, allow at most three alternating baseline/candidate pairs per cell under the same execution limits, with the same two-second sample target. Freeze the candidate before comparative capture; no parameter search or second candidate. Prefer a change only when attributable improvement clearly exceeds observed variation, other cells show no repeatable material regression, and storage and update costs remain acceptable. Record added bounded memory and registration/update work; do not hide a transfer of cost out of ACK processing. Otherwise recommend keeping the baseline or report uncertainty. The output is a recommendation and preserved scratch evidence, not a production patch to merge.

**Key interfaces and preservation:** `sentPacketHandler.ReceivedAck` is the real processing boundary; `recoveryEvidence.ack` classifies retained receipts; `recoveryEvidence.feedback` emits persistent-congestion and recovery-episode facts; `congestionPacketKey` preserves packet-number-space identity. Any candidate must preserve ACK-only gaps, cross-space transmission ordering, measured-at-send eligibility, unresolved/disposed/evicted-history conservatism, ending-ordinal deduplication, exact spurious-loss membership, current-path receipt authority (including the MTU/path-probe distinction), and path/Retry reset behavior. Keep the 32,768 outcome cap and bound any added index or summary; demonstrate eviction/disposal/reset cleanup. Preserve Reno, public API, wire behavior and existing ownership. Reuse the eight named T5 recovery tests and affected-package tests for a candidate; add only a focused regression for a newly changed invariant when existing coverage cannot distinguish it. A semantic failure rejects the candidate; it does not justify weakening tests or continuing performance tuning.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] A pinned baseline receipt accounts for all six cells, or explicitly records the finite-budget stop and missing evidence.
- [ ] The receipt includes commands, exact trace and measurement boundaries, host/tool/source identity, raw samples, allocation data, tail sample counts, profiles, variation and limitations.
- [ ] Both scans are exercised through valid real recovery behavior; setup and repeated duplicate-ACK shortcuts do not masquerade as ACK work.
- [ ] Any candidate satisfies the trigger and attribution rule, stays within the one-candidate budget, and records paired comparison, bounded storage/update costs and correctness results.
- [ ] The final disposition is keep, recommend a separately scoped production change, or inconclusive, with reasons. Passing local thresholds never claims native qualification.
- [ ] Scratch code and results are retained as immutable investigation evidence with a reproduction recipe, not installed as a maintained harness or CI timing gate. No candidate production changes are merged under this issue.

**Out of scope:** Shipping an optimization; adding a maintained benchmark framework; changing thresholds after seeing results; changing the recovery cap or correctness contracts; optimizing the ECN ledger; rerunning or expanding native qualification; modifying the accepted BBR frontier; consumer changes or rollout. No new glossary term or architectural decision is needed for this reversible measurement plan.

Post-merge revalidation from #622, RAS review `20260924T215718-232032a92897ad7b3a3cbe29`, C-001: the optional confirmation-scan optimization remains valid at merged commit `672f8cd48db2dbe612a33e001997e26446b078e4`.

[`recoveryEvidence.confirmPTO`, lines 155–165](https://github.com/the-sarge/quic-go-fast/blob/672f8cd48db2dbe612a33e001997e26446b078e4/internal/ackhandler/bbr_recovery.go#L155) returns without a witness; otherwise it makes one bounded ring pass even when there is no unresolved PTO-retired candidate. This is not a correctness failure or a demonstrated latency regression. #617 explicitly allowed that pass and did not authorize a performance campaign or maintained pending-candidate index.

Disposition: **defer to this existing ACK-processing-cost investigation**, with no duplicate issue or new blocker. Include the now-current ACK path when pinning the source for the already accepted finite measurements. This note adds no workload, sample, profile or shipping authorization to the final agent brief; any production optimization still needs its own accepted scope.

title: Assess bounded recovery outcome ACK-processing cost
